_about: The benchmark's pictures and how deep each is run (owner, 23 Nov: "core is 1 photo per group"; "extended is all 15"). Read by the runners: `npm run paint -- core|extended ...` (Auto and levels 2 to 4) and `node bench/scripts/run.mjs --round V3 --crops core|extended` (level 1), through tools/paint/run-sets.mjs; `node tools/paint/run-sets.mjs core` lists every painting a set asks for and starts nothing. id: the subject's id in the registry (SUBJECTS.json): always a registration made under the one-area sheet rule (tools/paint/sheet-rule.mjs), which carries the suffix -qs (tools/paint/reregister.mjs makes it from the earlier registration, which stays under its own id for earlier results); `node tools/paint/run-sets.mjs check` says which are registered and prepared, and a run of a benchmark picture not under the rule is refused. group: the kind of picture; the core has one of each. levelOne: the picture's level 1 target in bench/v3/crops.json (made by bench/scripts/add-level-one-target.mjs on the standard sheet), or null while none is made; a target without its rendering unit is refused by the level 1 runner.

full.what: the whole ladder: levels 1 to 4, and Auto, which every score is measured against

core.what: five pictures, one of each group, on the whole ladder

extended.what: all fifteen: the core five on the whole ladder, the other ten at Auto and level 2

roster.what: the ten models of the 0.4 benchmark (the owner, 23 Nov: "muse top end, gemini the family, codex the family, anthropic the family", without Hydrogen, Luna and Haiku), each at medium effort. A key names the model's entry in tools/paint/authors.json (levels 2 to 4) and in bench/models.json (level 1); `node tools/paint/run-sets.mjs check` says whether each has both, the same in both

rounds._about: The benchmark is run as FIXED ROUNDS (tools/paint/rounds.mjs; `npm run paint -- ... --work rounds`): no shell, no tools, the look budget of the open session. roster: the models, each with its family and its author key (tools/paint/authors.json). screening: the first stage. Every model of the roster paints the screening pictures at level 2; `node tools/paint/screening.mjs rank RESULTS.json` ranks them by their mean combined figure and names who goes on: `keep` of them (null: the top half, rounded up), and never fewer than one of each family. Those go on to the remaining core pictures and the other levels. `node tools/paint/screening.mjs plan` prints the stage's command and starts nothing.
